data.name: Your Daddy
data.detailed_description:
Your Daddy is a 3D desktop companion living right on your desktop.

Is your desktop feeling a little empty? Looking for a father figure who actually stays, supports you, and never leaves for bread? Then Your Daddy is here for you.

He follows your mouse cursor and keeps you company right on your desktop. Customize him however you like, move him around, resize him, dress him up, put him in different poses, and make him dance whenever you want. Interact with him through right-click options and supportive text reactions, and choose whether he sees you as his son or daughter for a more personal fatherly experience.

Features:

• 3D desktop companion living on your desktop
• Follows your mouse cursor
• Move, rotate, and scale the character
• Change outfits and customize his look
• Set different poses
• Activate dances and idle animations
• Right-click interaction menu
• Supportive text reactions
• Choose whether you’re his son or daughter

Content:

• Your Daddy character
• Multiple customization options
• Different poses, dances, and desktop interactions

Minimum:

  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
